sourceReport.normalization: report cases[].bundle changed to repository-relative paths; other fields unchanged

protocol.scope: Complete missing baseline snapshot capacity measurement; no optimization candidate or acceptance criteria change
protocol.search: Probe 4000 then double until first failure or 29000. Refine bracket in 1000 increments by binary search. At highest single-pass rate obtain at least 3 total independent trials; all supplied trials must pass. If a repeat fails, disqualify that rate and search below it. Stop when highest eligible rate has >=3 passes and immediately higher 1000-rate fails, or when 1000 fails and no eligible grid point is demonstrated. Preserve every trial. Max 24 trials; if exhausted report incomplete rather than relax gates.
